about.caption: FRANCISCO MYERS · CIUDAD GUAYANA
bio: I build web products with JavaScript and TypeScript, React and Node.js, and automations on Google Workspace. Before I wrote code, I ran the contracts database for works and services at an aluminium plant. That is where I learned to organise how information moves between users, contractors and internal teams.

Today I apply that judgement to APIs, databases and interfaces, mostly for organisations with small teams and real constraints. I like projects where one person owns the whole thing, from the spec to the deploy.
